scoring_justification: Recomputing the ratio and distortion from first principles (series expansions/Padé) in the lightweight verifier is infeasible, so we compare the agent's reported critical ratio and distortion values to the paper's published gold values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for ratio at Tc and distortion Δβ/β
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 3 and text: critical ratio 0.7986, distortion values [-0.004, -0.022, -0.102]
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's own reported quantitative results

outputs.description: The ratio ⟨σ₁⟩/σ as a function of reduced temperature and the probe-induced distortion Δβ/β over the three τ intervals. The checker compares the ratio at τ=0 and the distortion values to hidden reference values derived from the paper, within absolute tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier uses reference values derived from the paper; the exact reference values are not disclosed in the public contract.
